motion.name: authentication
motion.purpose: Preserved image push/retreat and panel choreography.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Official fluent-button with a thin Svelte adapter.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:32px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:#0067c0; color:#fff; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#005a9e; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0067c0; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Native Sensitive Field
components.description: Native password/passphrase; Fluent external label and delegated single focus indicator.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; font:14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-field input { min-height:32px; border:1px solid #d1d1d1; border-bottom-color:#616161; border-radius:4px; padding:0 12px; background:#fff; color:#242424; }

narrative.overview: Windows 11 hierarchy with Fluent 2 controls, shared across desktop and Android. Phase one establishes foundations, authentication and the application shell; complex business pages inherit these tokens and await individual migration.
keyCharacteristics: Native UI typography and compact working density.
Semantic Fluent themes and local system icons.
Native Windows Mica under stable content surfaces.
Acrylic-style transient surfaces and Smoke modal dimming.
Preserved circular fluid connection action and authentication image transition.

rules.name: One Theme Authority
rules.body: Runtime theme objects own values; legacy variables are aliases only.

rules.name: Material Has a Job
rules.body: Mica is the window base; Acrylic-style CSS is transient; Smoke dims blocking dialogs.

rules.name: Sensitive Fields Stay Native
rules.body: Never send a password or private-key passphrase to a reflecting custom text input.

rules.name: Preserve Signature Motion
rules.body: Keep circular connection feedback and the 600ms authentication choreography, with reduced-motion end states.

dos: Use Fluent across platforms and adapt input targets.
Keep security and bilingual copy unchanged.
Validate native Mica in a native client.
donts: Do not maintain independent Material and explorer palettes.
Do not replace business behavior for appearance.
Do not load remote UI assets at runtime.
